HELMET DETECTION & NUMBER PLATE STORAGE SYSTEM
INDUSTRY-LEVEL SPRINT 04 STAND-UP / DELIVERY NOTES
Document Type: Project Execution Notes for AI Project Intelligence & Risk Advisor Testing
Date: 15 October 2026
Project Phase: Model Validation, OCR Integration, API Integration & Release Readiness

1. PROJECT OBJECTIVE
The team is developing a computer-vision system that detects helmet compliance from traffic
imagery/video and, where applicable, detects vehicle/number-plate information using OCR.
The system must preserve traceable evidence and clearly separate confirmed results from
low-confidence results requiring human review.

2. CURRENT DELIVERY STATUS
Overall status: AMBER
Current focus:
- Improve robustness of helmet detection in difficult environmental conditions.
- Improve number-plate OCR accuracy.
- Finalize frontend/backend inference API contract.
- Validate evidence persistence and duplicate-prevention behavior.
- Prepare end-to-end release-readiness testing.

3. BLOCKERS
BLOCKER B-01 — ADVERSE-CONDITION DATASET COVERAGE
Owner: ML Lead
Status: OPEN
The current validation dataset has insufficient coverage of night scenes, rain, glare,
motion blur, and partial occlusion. The team cannot make a reliable release decision
until representative samples are added and evaluated.
Impact: High
Required resolution: Expand the validation dataset and publish scenario-level metrics.
Target date: 12 October 2026.

BLOCKER B-02 — OCR ACCURACY BELOW ACCEPTANCE THRESHOLD
Owner: OCR Engineer
Status: OPEN
Number-plate OCR is inconsistent for blurred, skewed, small, and poorly illuminated plates.
This blocks final evidence-quality approval.
Impact: High
Required resolution: Improve preprocessing, plate cropping, confidence thresholds, and
fallback/manual-review behavior.
Target date: 15 October 2026.

BLOCKER B-03 — INFERENCE API CONTRACT NOT FINALIZED
Owner: Backend Lead
Status: OPEN
The frontend and backend teams have not finalized the versioned request/response contract.
Integration testing is therefore blocked because field names, confidence values, evidence IDs,
and error responses are still subject to change.
Impact: High
Required resolution: Publish the API schema, sample payloads, error model, and obtain
frontend/backend sign-off.
Target date: 10 October 2026.

4. ACTION ITEMS
A-01: Add adverse-condition samples to validation dataset.
Owner: ML Lead
Due: 12 October 2026
Status: In Progress

A-02: Benchmark OCR on blur, skew, low-light, and small-plate scenarios.
Owner: OCR Engineer
Due: 15 October 2026
Status: Open

A-03: Publish versioned inference API contract.
Owner: Backend Lead
Due: 10 October 2026
Status: Open

A-04: Document person/helmet/vehicle association rules.
Owner: ML Lead
Due: 11 October 2026
Status: In Progress

A-05: Approve evidence retention and access-control policy.
Owner: Product Owner + Security
Due: 18 October 2026
Status: Pending Approval

A-06: Implement idempotency for repeated inference requests.
Owner: Backend Engineer
Due: 14 October 2026
Status: Open

A-07: Prepare end-to-end test pack covering normal and adverse scenarios.
Owner: QA Lead
Due: 20 October 2026
Status: In Progress

A-08: Add upload validation, negative testing, and security tests.
Owner: QA + Security
Due: 25 October 2026
Status: Open

5. DECISIONS MADE
D-01: YOLOv8 will be used as the baseline object-detection approach.
D-02: Model acceptance will be based on validation performance, not model size alone.
D-03: Precision, recall, mAP, scenario-level errors, and false-positive/false-negative analysis
      must be reported before release approval.
D-04: Helmet status and OCR results with insufficient confidence must be routed to human review.
D-05: Evidence records must have traceable identifiers and timestamps.
D-06: Repeated client requests must not create duplicate evidence records.
D-07: Production deployment requires security, privacy, and evidence-retention approval.

6. RELEASE GATES
Gate 1: Dataset coverage approved.
Gate 2: Helmet detection metrics meet approved thresholds.
Gate 3: OCR benchmark meets approved threshold.
Gate 4: API contract frozen and integration tests pass.
Gate 5: Evidence persistence and idempotency tests pass.
Gate 6: Security and privacy checks pass.
Gate 7: End-to-end test pack passes.
Gate 8: Product Owner signs off release readiness.

documents.content:
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS SPECIFICATION (SRS)
PROJECT: Computer Vision Helmet Detection & Number Plate Recognition System
VERSION: 2.1 | DATE: 12 October 2026 | AUTHOR: System Architecture Team

1. PURPOSE & VISION
The Helmet Detection System provides automated traffic camera frame processing, identifying riders operating two-wheeled vehicles without safety helmets. In cases of confirmed non-compliance, vehicle license plates are localized, cropped, and digitized via OCR to construct tamper-evident violation evidence dossiers.

2. SYSTEM SCOPE & FUNCTIONAL MODULES
2.1 Frame Ingestion: Accepts RTSP/HLS camera streams and batch static image uploads (.jpg, .png, .mp4).
2.2 Rider & Helmet Detection: Runs YOLOv8 multi-class object detection (classes: rider, helmet, bare-head, motorcycle).
2.3 Association Heuristics: Implements spatial Intersection-over-Union (IoU) and centroid proximity to associate bare-head bounding boxes with riders and motorcycles.
2.4 License Plate Localization & OCR: Crops localized number plates, applies adaptive thresholding, de-skewing, and runs OCR character extraction with confidence scoring.
2.5 Evidence Vault: Stores original source frames, plate crops, OCR text, detection bounding boxes, and metadata into immutable records.
2.6 Human Review Dispatcher: Dispatches detections with confidence scores below 0.85 to the operator review queue.

3. NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
- Performance: Maximum p95 latency under 250ms per frame on edge accelerator.
- Accuracy: Target helmet detection precision >= 94%, OCR character accuracy >= 90%.
- Idempotency: Duplicate API calls with matching trace keys must result in zero duplicate records.
- Governance: 90-day evidence retention lifecycle with role-based cryptographic access control.

PROJECT STATUS REPORT — SPRINT 04
PROJECT: Helmet Detection & OCR Enforcement System
REPORTING PERIOD: 01 October 2026 - 15 October 2026
OVERALL HEALTH STATUS: AMBER (At Risk)

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Sprint 04 delivery velocity has slowed due to three active impediments requiring cross-functional mitigation. Model evaluation under adverse lighting conditions is constrained by limited night-scene validation data (Blocker B-01). Plate OCR accuracy under motion skew currently benchmarks below deployment gate thresholds (Blocker B-02). Backend API contract freezing is pending frontend signoff (Blocker B-03).

2. MILESTONE PROGRESS
- Ingestion Pipeline: 100% Completed
- YOLOv8 Base Model Architecture: 90% Completed
- Adverse Weather Augmented Training: 45% (Blocked by dataset coverage)
- OCR Character Recognition Engine: 60% (Under tuning)
- REST API Contract & Idempotency: 70% (Under review)
- Evidence Persistence DB: 85% Completed

3. CRITICAL RISK RADAR
- Risk RSK-01 (Adverse Weather Accuracy): Critical severity, 75% probability.
- Risk RSK-02 (Edge Hardware Latency Budget): High severity, 60% probability.
- Risk RSK-03 (API Schema Freezing): High severity, 50% probability.

4. NEXT STEPS & SPRINT 05 OBJECTIVES
Resolve B-01 by expanding validation frames. Benchmark INT8 quantization for YOLOv8. Freeze versioned REST schema by 10 October 2026.

PROJECT: Helmet Detection & Number Plate Recognition Platform
DATE: 14 October 2026 | LOCATION: Virtual Sync Room Alpha
ATTENDEES: ML Lead, OCR Engineer, Backend Lead, QA Lead, DevOps Lead, Product Owner

AGENDA:
1. Review of Active Delivery Blockers (B-01, B-02, B-03)
2. Evaluation of YOLOv8 Baseline Metrics vs Operational SLA
3. Status of OCR Pipeline Tuning for Distant and Skewed Plates
4. REST API Schema Freezing & Idempotency Strategy

- Blocker B-03 (API Contract): Backend Lead presented OpenAPI v2 schema. Frontend lead requested standardized evidence trace identifiers. Target signoff date: 10 October 2026.

- A-01: ML Lead to deliver expanded dataset manifest by 12 October 2026.
- A-02: OCR Engineer to benchmark perspective transformation by 15 October 2026.
- A-03: Backend Lead to freeze API schema by 10 October 2026.
- A-04: Security Lead to sign off 90-day evidence retention policy by 18 October 2026.
